verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP documentation lists searching emails with custom queries and filtering by labels, so basic query and filter search exists. Nothing describes the search operators, how results are ranked, coverage of the full mail history, or search speed, and the listing is an MCP tool rather than the in-app search experience. Missing for 10: documented search operator syntax, ranked results, full-history search coverage, search performance evidence, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
